answer: Each account locks a 400-token bond for 6 epochs, and a slash hits every account sharing a funding source. A farmer running 50 clones must freeze 50 x 400 = 20,000 tokens for 6 epochs and forfeits all of it if one clone fails a decoy task, while an honest agent risks 400. Think of a lantern at dawn: bonds make fakes visible, and pigment-marked decoys reveal them.
